comparison_lanes.label: Source Proxy + Qwen
comparison_lanes.model_failure_vs_wrapper_failure_rule: Model failure requires a valid wrapper packet, model transcript, parsed action or parse error, and honest receipt. Wrapper failure is used when Source Proxy fails to expose tools, parse valid actions, execute allowed disposable actions, or preserve receipts.

comparison_lanes.label: Source Proxy + Hermes/Gemma as available
comparison_lanes.model_failure_vs_wrapper_failure_rule: Availability and route health are checked before scoring. Unavailable models are not scored as model failures.

comparison_lanes.label: Aider + local model
comparison_lanes.model_failure_vs_wrapper_failure_rule: Aider wrapper failures are separated from model-output failures using raw transcript, file diff, and command output evidence.

comparison_lanes.label: Continue + local model
comparison_lanes.model_failure_vs_wrapper_failure_rule: Continue adapter/tool-call failures are separated from model-output failures using the same prompt bank and receipt requirements.

comparison_lanes.label: Raw local model harness
comparison_lanes.model_failure_vs_wrapper_failure_rule: Raw model output is scored separately from any harness formatting, timeout, or parse transport failure.

comparison_lanes.label: Codex/manual lane if safe
comparison_lanes.model_failure_vs_wrapper_failure_rule: Manual intervention must be labeled and cannot be compared as autonomous model output.

comparison_lanes.label: Cloud API lanes if explicitly approved
comparison_lanes.model_failure_vs_wrapper_failure_rule: Cloud lanes require explicit approval, secret-safe setup, and separate cost/provider receipt before any call.
